notes.text: HTTP clients make REST calls to CHAT (FastAPI) and make REST calls to PUBLIC_API (FastAPI); web (Next.js 14) makes REST calls to INTERACTION (Flask).
CHAT (FastAPI) and INTERACTION (Flask) read + write PostgreSQL; INTERACTION (Flask) also long-polls SQS and enqueues SQS tasks.

AGENT · REALTIMEAGENT · EXTRACTIONAGENT · ASYNC_AGENT workers, SOR · BATCH · BACKFILL · INTEGRATION workers and OUTREACH · WORKFLOWSCHEDULER workers long-poll SQS; AGENT · REALTIMEAGENT · EXTRACTIONAGENT · ASYNC_AGENT workers also read + write PostgreSQL and make API calls to LLM providers; SOR · BATCH · BACKFILL · INTEGRATION workers also read + write PostgreSQL; and also AGENT · REALTIMEAGENT · EXTRACTIONAGENT · ASYNC_AGENT workers enqueue follow-up SQS tasks; and also SOR · BATCH · BACKFILL · INTEGRATION workers enqueue follow-up SQS tasks.
